hierarchy.label: text-xs font-ibm-plex uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-[#111111]

layout.grid_system: Control Room Pattern. Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Gap Strategy: gap-6.
layout.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard p-4 to p-8. Dashboard cards should have p-6 inner padding.
layout.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use flat solid surfaces. No glassmorphism. Use 1px sharp borders `border-[#E5E5E5]` with no shadow. Maintain optical clarity.

components.buttons: Square or rounded-sm. Solid background for primary (#002FA7), transparent with 1px black border for secondary. High contrast hover states. Use `data-testid` on all buttons.
components.cards: bg-white border border-[#E5E5E5] rounded-sm flex flex-col items-start p-6
components.stepper: Horizontal pipeline timeline with sharp connected lines. Active node uses #002FA7.
components.tabs: Minimalist tabs with sharp 1px bottom border. Active tab has #111111 bottom border, inactive has transparent.
components.badges: Square or very slightly rounded. High contrast (e.g., bg-[#002FA7] text-white for Active, bg-[#E5E5E5] text-[#111111] for Draft)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard detail page adhering strictly to the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' archetype.
Add 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'IBM Plex Sans' to the application via Google Fonts or standard imports.
Install and use `@phosphor-icons/react` or standard `lucide-react` with 1.5px stroke.
The layout must start with a Header (Logo, Name, Category, Badges, and Action Buttons).
Immediately below the Header, render the Pipeline/Onboarding stepper horizontally spanning full width.
Below the Stepper, deploy a 4-column Grid: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6`.
Left Column (`col-span-1`): Place 'Company Details' and 'Contacts' list.

Middle Column (`col-span-2`): Place 'Agreement & Financial Terms' at the top (with clear SOR/Outright split), followed by a Tabbed Interface for 'Activity Logs', 'Emails (Sent/Received)', and 'Notes'.
Right Column (`col-span-1`): Place the 'Tasks' section, allowing quick additions and checkboxes for completion.
Apply sharp borders (`border border-[#E5E5E5]`) on all cards instead of shadows. No soft shadows allowed.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit `data-testid` attributes.
Hover states must trigger explicit color shifts (e.g., `hover:bg-[#E5E5E5] hover:text-[#111111]`), no generic opacity drops.
Keep typography strict: `text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em]` for labels, `text-2xl font-cabinet font-medium` for major headings.
